newsitem.title: USA: KTI issues $21.4 mln in preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: KTI issues $21.4 mln in preferred stock.

text.p: KTI Inc said Monday it closed a placement of $21.4 million in Series B convertible, exchangeable preferred stock.
The issue is convertible at $11.75 per share. It carries an 8.75 percent dividend coupon and was sold to institutional buyers and is exchangeable for convertible debentures at the company's option.

"The proceeds from this transaction are earmarked for acquisitions presently being negotiated in the energy and recycling fields augmenting our current business lines," President Martin Sergi said in a statement.
KTI is an environmental company engaged in integrated waste processing and management in diversified services and markets.
